name: codex-bridge
description: Use OpenAI Codex as a Claude Code subagent through the native Agent, SendMessage, ListAgents and TaskStop tools.

fast.title: Codex fast mode
fast.description: on: priority service tier; off: default tier; inherit: whatever ~/.codex/config.toml says.

model.title: Codex default model
model.description: Model for new codex subagent sessions (e.g. gpt-6-astra). Empty: codex's own default. Claude can still pick one with `@codex model=...`.

effort.title: Codex default reasoning effort
effort.description: Effort for new codex subagent sessions unless Claude passes one. inherit: codex's own default.

sandbox.title: Codex sandbox
sandbox.description: follow-claude: plan -> read-only, bypassPermissions -> danger-full-access, otherwise workspace-write. inherit: ~/.codex/config.toml.

approval.title: Codex approvals
approval.description: Nobody can answer codex's prompts from a subagent. follow-claude: auto mode -> codex auto-review, otherwise never. inherit: ~/.codex/config.toml.

codexPath.title: codex executable
codexPath.description: Path to the codex CLI, or a name found on PATH.
